raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Interim guard for #48974: LoRA adapters carrying `kv_b_proj` weights on MLA models currently load with zero warnings and are silently never applied. Until the real fix lands (#56718, currently in merge conflicts, with a proposed consolidation into #56327), loading such an adapter should fail visibly.

## Claims

- An adapter whose every LoRA module targets `kv_b_proj` (and has no `modules_to_save`) is now **rejected** with a `ValueError` citing #48974 — loading it is a provable complete no-op (verified on hardware: large-`lora_B` `kv_b_proj`-only adapter produces outputs byte-identical to base, [evidence on the issue](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48974#issuecomment-6155402656)).
- A mixed adapter (working targets + `kv_b_proj`) still loads, with a loud one-line warning that the `kv_b_proj` deltas are not applied — rejecting it would break adapters whose other modules work.
- MLA is detected **structurally** (`any(isinstance(m, MLAAttention) ...)` at manager init) rather than via `model_config.use_mla`, whose hard-coded model-type list misses some MLA checkpoints (e.g. `sarvam_mla`); the structural check covers every family that instantiates `MLAAttention` (directly, via `MultiHeadLatentAttentionWrapper`, or the Transformers backend) and stays off on DeepSeek's non-MLA fallback paths, which build a different attention class.
- The guard runs in `WorkerLoRAManager._load_adapter` — the path every production entry point takes (runtime `add_lora`, `--lora-modules`, engine args) — and deliberately not in `_add_adapter`, where warmup dummy LoRAs (which cover all wrapped modules, `kv_b_proj` included) would warn spuriously.

## Validation

Full `tests/lora/test_lora_manager.py` on an A100 against nightly `vllm 0.32.0rc1.dev100+g77154ca61` (`torch 2.13.0+cu129`) with the two source files from this diff overlaid:

```
$ python -m pytest tests/lora/test_lora_manager.py -q
35 passed in 20.44s
```

28 pre-existing tests unaffected; the 7 new cases (5 tests) cover reject / warn / pass-through semantics, the structural detection helper, and the `_load_adapter` wiring. Lint: `ruff format --check` / `ruff check` (pinned v0.14.0) pass on all three files.

The three new tests exercise the real guard method (reject / warn / non-MLA pass-through via the file's existing `__new__` validator-test convention), the real structural detection helper, and the `_load_adapter` wiring (monkeypatch-assert the validator is invoked). All CPU-only, no downloads.

## Details

- Validation inspects the loaded `LoRAModel.loras` dict, not `adapter_config.target_modules`, because config `target_modules` may name modules absent from the checkpoint — safetensor keys are the source of truth. `kv_b_proj` is never part of any `packed_modules_mapping`, so names are still raw at validation time.
- Root cause being guarded (not fixed here): decode uses absorbed `W_UK`/`W_UV` computed from raw weights, and the prefill path calls `impl.kv_b_proj` — a plain attribute on a non-`nn.Module` that LoRA's alias rewiring never reaches. Full trace on #48974.
- This is deliberately interim and trivially removable: one validator method + call site + tests, no semantic coupling. Whichever of #56718/#56327 makes `kv_b_proj` apply should delete it.
- Not a duplicate: no open PR adds load-time guarding for this; #56718/#56327 change the application path itself (and are stalled/unreviewed respectively).
- AI assistance (Claude Code) was used. I reviewed every changed line; the test commands and results above are from my own runs.

---

@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@
 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 
 import os
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
 
 import pytest
 import torch
@@ -25,10 +26,12 @@
     LoRAMapping,
     LoRAModelManager,
     LRUCacheLoRAModelManager,
+    _has_mla_attention,
 )
 from vllm.lora.peft_helper import PEFTHelper
 from vllm.lora.request import LoRARequest
 from vllm.lora.worker_manager import LRUCacheWorkerLoRAManager, WorkerLoRAManager
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import MLAAttention
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import GateLinear
 from vllm.platforms import current_platform
 
@@ -111,6 +114,84 @@ def test_moe_format_validation_allows_supported_layouts(
     manager._validate_moe_lora_format(adapter)
 
 
+KV_B_PROJ = "model.layers.0.self_attn.kv_b_proj"
+Q_PROJ = "model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj"
+
+
+def _make_mla_guard_fixtures(
+    is_mla: bool, module_names: list[str]
+) -> tuple[LoRAModelManager, LoRAModel]:
+    manager = LoRAModelManager.__new__(LoRAModelManager)
+    manager._is_mla = is_mla
+    loras = {
+        name: LoRALayerWeights(name, 8, 16, torch.zeros(8, 4), torch.zeros(4, 8))
+        for name in module_names
+    }
+    return manager, LoRAModel(1, 8, loras)
+
+
+def test_mla_lora_guard_rejects_kv_b_proj_only_adapter():
+    """A kv_b_proj-only adapter is a complete no-op on MLA models (#48974)."""
+    manager, adapter = _make_mla_guard_fixtures(True, [KV_B_PROJ])
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="48974") as exc:
+        manager._validate_mla_lora(adapter)
+    assert "not applied on MLA models" in str(exc.value)
+
+
+def test_mla_lora_guard_warns_on_mixed_adapter(caplog_vllm):
+    """kv_b_proj among working targets loads, with a loud warning."""
+    manager, adapter = _make_mla_guard_fixtures(True, [KV_B_PROJ, Q_PROJ])
+    manager._validate_mla_lora(adapter)
+    assert "kv_b_proj" in caplog_vllm.text
+    assert "48974" in caplog_vllm.text
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "is_mla,module_names",
+    [
+        (True, [Q_PROJ]),
+        (False, [KV_B_PROJ]),
+        (False, [KV_B_PROJ, Q_PROJ]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_mla_lora_guard_ignores_unaffected_adapters(is_mla, module_names, caplog_vllm):
+    """No guard for non-MLA models or MLA adapters without kv_b_proj."""
+    manager, adapter = _make_mla_guard_fixtures(is_mla, module_names)
+    manager._validate_mla_lora(adapter)
+    assert "48974" not in caplog_vllm.text
+
+
+def test_mla_detection_is_structural():
+    """Config-based `use_mla` misses some MLA model types (e.g. sarvam_mla)."""
+
+    class _FakeMLAAttention(MLAAttention):
+        def __init__(self):
+            nn.Module.__init__(self)
+
+    assert _has_mla_attention(nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(4, 4), _FakeMLAAttention()))
+    assert not _has_mla_attention(nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(4, 4)))
+
+
+def test_load_adapter_invokes_mla_guard(monkeypatch):
+    """The worker load path must run the MLA guard on every loaded adapter."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "vllm.lora.worker_manager.get_adapter_absolute_path", lambda path: path
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr("vllm.lora.worker_manager.PEFTHelper", MagicMock())
+    worker = WorkerLoRAManager.__new__(WorkerLoRAManager)
+    worker._lora_model_cls = MagicMock()
+    worker.max_position_embeddings = 16
+    worker.lora_config = LoRAConfig(max_lora_rank=8)
+    worker.vocab_size = 32
+    worker._adapter_manager = MagicMock(
+        supported_lora_modules=["q_proj"], packed_modules_mapping={}
+    )
+
+    lora = worker._load_adapter(LoRARequest("1", 1, "some/path"))
+
+    worker._adapter_manager._validate_mla_lora.assert_called_once_with(lora)
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("device", DEVICES)
 def test_from_lora_tensors(qwen3_lora_files, device):
     tensors = load_file(os.path.join(qwen3_lora_files, "adapter_model.safetensors"))

@@ -37,6 +37,7 @@
     process_packed_modules_mapping,
     replace_submodule,
 )
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import MLAAttention
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import MoERunner
 from vllm.model_executor.models import (
     SupportsLoRA,
@@ -59,6 +60,11 @@
 class SupportsLoRAModel(nn.Module, SupportsLoRA): ...
 
 
+def _has_mla_attention(model: nn.Module) -> bool:
+    """Detect MLA structurally; config `use_mla` misses some MLA model types."""
+    return any(isinstance(module, MLAAttention) for module in model.modules())
+
+
 class AdapterLRUCache(LRUCache[int, T]):
     def __init__(self, capacity: int, deactivate_fn: Callable[[int], object]):
         super().__init__(capacity)
@@ -161,6 +167,7 @@ def __init__(
         self._use_ep = bool(
             vllm_config and vllm_config.parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel
         )
+        self._is_mla = _has_mla_attention(self.model)
         self._init_punica_wrapper(max_num_batched_tokens, vllm_config)
         self._create_lora_modules()
 
@@ -1270,6 +1277,34 @@ def _validate_moe_lora_format(self, lora_model: LoRAModel) -> None:
                     "is_3d_lora_weight=True on the LoRA request."
                 )
 
+    def _validate_mla_lora(self, lora_model: LoRAModel) -> None:
+        """Interim guard for kv_b_proj LoRA weights on MLA models.
+
+        MLA decode uses W_UK/W_UV absorbed from the base kv_b_proj weights and
+        prefill calls the unwrapped layer, so kv_b_proj LoRA weights are never
+        applied. Remove once https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48974
+        is fixed.
+        """
+        if not self._is_mla:
+            return
+        kv_b_modules = [
+            name for name in lora_model.loras if name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] == "kv_b_proj"
+        ]
+        if not kv_b_modules:
+            return
+        msg = (
+            f"LoRA adapter {lora_model.id} targets kv_b_proj, whose LoRA "
+            "weights are not applied on MLA models. See "
+            "https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48974."
+        )
+        only_kv_b = len(kv_b_modules) == len(lora_model.loras)
+        if only_kv_b and not lora_model.modules_to_save:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{msg} This adapter only targets kv_b_proj, so loading it "
+                "would be a silent no-op."
+            )
+        logger.warning("%s Its kv_b_proj weights are ignored.", msg)
+
     def _validate_modules_to_save(self, lora_model: LoRAModel) -> None:
         if not lora_model.modules_to_save:
             return

@@ -154,6 +154,9 @@ def _load_adapter(self, lora_request: LoRARequest) -> LoRAModel:
             # 3D->2D conversion when running under the universal 2D wrapper.
             lora.is_3d_lora_weight = lora_request.is_3d_lora_weight
             self._adapter_manager._validate_moe_lora_format(lora)
+            # Not in _add_adapter: warmup dummy LoRAs cover kv_b_proj and
+            # would spuriously warn there.
+            self._adapter_manager._validate_mla_lora(lora)
 
             # Validate classification-head weights.
             self._adapter_manager._validate_modules_to_save(lora)
